```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plyranges)
```

Download from (https://shendure.curve.space/articles/evolutionary-transfer-learning/data)
```{r}
bed_path <- "data/STEAM-v1/mm10/Supplementary_File_3_Evolution_Augmented_Model_Predict_On_Mouse_Genome.bed"
std_chr <- paste0("chr",c(1:22, "X", "Y"))
mm10_pred_enh_gr <- read.delim(bed_path) %>% 
  dplyr::rename("seqnames"="chr") %>%
  filter(seqnames %in% std_chr) %>%
  plyranges::as_granges() %>%
  GenomicRanges::sort()

```

```{r}
mm10_pred_enh_gr_lst <- split(mm10_pred_enh_gr, mm10_pred_enh_gr$cell_class)
cell_classes <- names(mm10_pred_enh_gr_lst)
n <- length(cell_classes)
lengths(mm10_pred_enh_gr_lst) %>%
  enframe()%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value))+
  geom_histogram()
```

```{r cross-tissues-overlap}

cell_classes <- names(mm10_pred_enh_gr_lst)
n <- length(cell_classes)

jaccard_gr <- function(a, b) {
  inter <- GenomicRanges::intersect(a, b)
  uni   <- GenomicRanges::union(a, b)
  w_uni <- sum(GenomicRanges::width(uni))
  if (w_uni == 0) return(0)
  sum(GenomicRanges::width(inter)) / w_uni
}

count_mat   <- matrix(0L, n, n, dimnames = list(cell_classes, cell_classes))
jaccard_mat <- matrix(0,  n, n, dimnames = list(cell_classes, cell_classes))

for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  for (j in seq_len(i)) {
    gr_i <- mm10_pred_enh_gr_lst[[i]]
    gr_j <- mm10_pred_enh_gr_lst[[j]]
    n_ov <- length(plyranges::find_overlaps(gr_i, gr_j))
    jac  <- jaccard_gr(gr_i, gr_j)
    count_mat[i, j]   <- count_mat[j, i]   <- n_ov
    jaccard_mat[i, j] <- jaccard_mat[j, i] <- jac
  }
}

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  count_mat,
  main          = "Peak overlap counts",
  color         = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#08519c"))(50),
  cluster_rows  = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE
)

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  jaccard_mat,
  main          = "Jaccard similarity (bp-level)",
  color         = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#a50f15"))(50),
  cluster_rows  = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
targets::tar_load(yoshida_2020_ocr_gr)
```

```{r}
l <- lapply(mm10_pred_enh_gr_lst, function(x){
  plyranges::find_overlaps(x,
                         yoshida_2020_ocr_gr) %>% 
    plyranges::reduce_ranges()
  })
```

```{r}
c(lengths(l)/lengths(mm10_pred_enh_gr_lst)) %>%
  sort %>% 
  enframe() %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = name))%>%
  ggplot(aes(name, value))+
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue")+
  ylab("Proportion of overlapping core-enhancers peaks")+
  xlab("")+
  coord_flip()
```
